name: Kaze no Tawamure ~ Episode Yuri Hen
source:
For fans of the upskirt and cuckoldry genres,
Digital Harmonica presents a college student Netorare ADV Game.

The images follow the heroine's seduction and trajectory of fall.
Perspective is not only the protagonist's but the heroine's, creating a flavor
of story you don't always get to experience with this genre.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE157436.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
对于超短裙和通奸类型的粉丝来说，
Digital Harmonica推出一款大学生Netorare ADV游戏。

这些图像跟随女主人公的诱惑和堕落的轨迹。
视角不只有主角，还有女主角，别有一番风味
你并不总能体验到这种类型的故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE157436.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
